mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET login_fail_count = LEAST(login_fail_count + 1, 2147483647), lock_until = CASE WHEN login_fail_count + 1 >= #{maxFailCount} THEN TIMESTAMPADD('MINUTE', #{lockMinutes}, NOW()) ELSE lock_until END WHERE id = #{userId} AND (lock_until IS NULL OR lock_until <= NOW())

UPDATE sys_user SET login_fail_count = MIN(login_fail_count + 1, 2147483647), lock_until = CASE WHEN login_fail_count + 1 >= #{maxFailCount} THEN datetime('now', 'localtime', '+' || #{lockMinutes} || ' minutes') ELSE lock_until END WHERE id = #{userId} AND (lock_until IS NULL OR lock_until <= datetime('now', 'localtime'))

UPDATE sys_user SET login_fail_count = LEAST(login_fail_count + 1, 2147483647), lock_until = CASE WHEN login_fail_count + 1 >= #{maxFailCount} THEN DATEADD('MINUTE', #{lockMinutes}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE lock_until END WHERE id = #{userId} AND (lock_until IS NULL OR lock_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
